targets.authors: Humphrey, Jamie L.; Root, Elisabeth D.
targets.title: Spatio-temporal neighborhood impacts on internalizing and externalizing behaviors in U.S. elementary school children: Effect modification by child and family socio-demographics
targets.evidence_quote: Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate a claim from Humphrey_SocSciMed_2017_Eb2N
targets.outcome_quote: Result: This claim was replicated. The overall effect (the coefficient on Hispanic) is -0.21836630 and its p-value is 0.017895.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict for the single selected claim reports successful replication with a negative significant Hispanic coefficient.

reasoning: GUID resolves directly to the complete SCORE report DOCX for the assigned Humphrey/Root secondary-data replication. Report team is Bob Reed, Jianhua Duan and Sanghyun Hong (overlapping assigned authors); Parsons et al. appear to be broader project attribution, not report byline. Classified as replication because secondary-data project identifies an ECLS-K:2011 cohort and tests the selected finding, rather than claiming recovery of original numerical results. Original publication abstract identifies ECLS-K without the 2011 designation. Residual uncertainty: brief report does not expressly contrast the two cohort vintages.
